confidence_notes: Food and drink anchors come from two web searches: the RBA search and one cost-of-living search. The cost-of-living search returned Numbeo-based figures (Expatica, June 2026), MyLifeElsewhere and Combien-coûte, which are crowdsourced and vary between sources. I converted euro prices to USD at about 1.16 USD per EUR, which is my own assumption and not a searched rate. I did not search cocktail or wine prices. I set them from the typical Italian relationship to beer: a cocktail at roughly twice the beer price, and a wine glass at about the beer price. Accommodation anchors are holistic estimates, not checked against any listings. They are the least certain, because La Spezia is a Cinque Terre base and July prices are seasonally high. The RBA figure is the 18 November 2026 rate; I could not confirm whether a later one had been published.
comparable_city_reasoning: Compared with other mid-sized Italian Riviera and Ligurian cities. Restaurant prices are close to the Italian average, and summer accommodation is lifted by Cinque Terre tourism demand.
